answer.location_description: Top-right corner region of the image, roughly the first 6-7 rows and columns 14-21. This is well outside the centred nodule, which spans about rows/cols 6-18.
answer.shortcut_type: bright localized patch/marker in top-right corner
answer.mechanism: Two low-bias hidden units, 0 and 18, carry concentrated positive weights on the top-right patch and otherwise hold only weak nodule structure. Their summed downstream paths are net positive, mainly through layer-2 units u2, u3 and u5, so they push the logit toward malignant (unit 18 strongly, unit 0 mildly). The same patch is also wired in through the nodule-texture units. The negative-bias 'bright surroundings' units (16, 20, 30) have positive weights there, and unit 16 feeds malignant strongly via u2, u12 and u15. The positive-bias 'dark surroundings' units (3, 14, 15, 19, 24, 26, 28) have negative weights there, and unit 14 is strongly benign-promoting via u9, u12 and u15. Brightness in that corner therefore raises the malignant pathways and suppresses the benign pathways.
answer.evidence: Unit 18: r0 cols15-17 = 47,40,41; r3 cols17-19 = 41,37,40; r4 col15 = 45, col19 = 42; r6 cols17-20 = 43,45,47,31. Unit 0: r0 cols15-17 = 34,44,45; r2 cols15-16 = 34,41; r3 col16 = 48; r4 col15 = 43; r5 cols19-21 = 38,41,24. Unit 16: r3 cols15-16 = 55,45. Unit 30: r4 cols15-16 = 43,48. Unit 20: r0 cols14-16 = 45,34,50. Mirror-image negatives in benign-leaning units: unit 14 r0 cols16-20 = -46..-38; unit 19 r0 cols14-16 = -41,-43,-47 and r3 col16 = -43; unit 15 r3 cols14-16 = -41,-41,-45; unit 26 r3 col15 = -49. Rough path sums (ignoring ReLU gating): unit 18 about +5.9k and unit 16 about +33k integer units toward the logit, while unit 14 is about -16k. Because the nodule is centred and rescaled, consistent sign-coherent weighting of one off-centre corner across many units is not explained by nodule anatomy, which suggests an artifact. Caveat: some of the corner weighting overlaps with the general periphery rings, so confidence is moderate.
answer.main_feature: The model mainly uses centred ring and blob templates of the nodule and its margin. Units 3/5/14/15/19/21/23/24/26/28 versus 11/16/20/27/30 contrast a compact bright nodule with dark lung around it against irregular, spiculated or attached bright structure around the nodule border, which reads as malignant.
